title: Self-portrait with bandaged ear, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Wonderful gift for painting lovers Design inspired by the picture frame Fulfillment of a dream of unique art collection Pure silver and modern decoration techniques The painter produced a stunningly conventional yet confident creative execution in 1889. Vincent van Gogh saw painting as his redemption, a method to escape the cruelties of the actual world into the vibrant world of images. The artist attempts to gain courage in his struggle with crazy by representing himself, but he is unable to do it. This silver coin with miniature reproduction is in the style of the original painting and will make an excellent addition to your home collection!
